title: Continuous integral constructibility and degree-zero complete objects
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite and X Noetherian of finite dimension with l invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. For the valuation subring A and its actual continuous coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module], there is an equivalence e from A_X-module sheaves to the completed integral coefficient modules [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models] such that, for every module M, M is continuous-constructible if and only if the degree-zero single object e(M)[0] lies in the bounded constructible complete category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. No torsion-freeness or local freeness of M is required.

proof.text: Take the normalized ring and coefficient-sheaf isomorphisms from the coefficient comparison and let e be their explicit module restriction equivalence. The slice-model comparison then applies to e. A covering family gives a covering sieve consisting of the arrows factoring through a family member. Restrict its local model isomorphisms along such arrows with overMap and overFunctorMap. Conversely index a covering sieve by its arrows; the resulting objects cover the terminal object. Apply the slice comparison to every such object in each stratum. Keeping the same finite stratification in both directions identifies continuous constructibility of M with IsIntegralStratifiedFinitelyPresented(e(M)).

The integral stratified-perfect characterization identifies membership in the complete category with bounded constructible cohomology. For a single degree-zero object, homology in degree zero is naturally the original module and all other homology objects are zero. The finite local model condition is invariant under isomorphisms. The triangulated complete category contains zero, whose homology supplies the zero model condition. Consequently bounded constructible cohomology of e(M)[0] is equivalent to the finite local model condition for e(M). Combine this with step 1.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousIntegralConstructibleComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] [IsNoetherian X]
    (hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n) (hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    ∃ e : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        (latticeModuleRing X (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E)) ≌
        Scheme.pbcModules X (Scheme.pbcAdicCompletion X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E)),
      ∀ M, IsContinuousConstructible X (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E) M ↔
        Scheme.PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (e.functor.obj M))
